title: Hands Across the Border
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) helps a slain rancher's daughter (Ruth Terry) breed horses for the Army.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Hurricane Horseman
description: A gunsmith (Lane Chandler) offers to fix outlaws' guns if they release their hostage to him.

title: Rawhide
description: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: The Dawn Rider
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

title: The Outlaw
description: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
description: In their first cinematic outing, Red Ryder and his Indian sidekick help a newspaper publisher clean up her town.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: Frontier Justice
description: A practical joker (Hoot Gibson) rescues his cattleman father from shady sheepmen.

title: New Mexico
description: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.

title: Jesse James Rides Again
description: On the run from the law over false charges, Jesse James and his friend find refuge in a small town threatened by a gang trying to claim the oil deposits beneath it. While there, he meets a pretty woman and father who are in danger.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

title: Under California Stars
description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers.

title: Blue Steel
description: Marshal John Carruthers helps a sheriff find out who stole the town's payroll, and together they discover the town's leader stole the money to buy up all the land.

title: Randy Rides Alone
description: Government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) is accused of shooting up a saloon and has to escape from the jail to find the man behind the murders.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
description: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: Abilene Town
description: A saloon singer (Ann Dvorak) and her rival like a marshal (Randolph Scott) who cleans up a drunken sheriff's (Edgar Buchanan) cow town.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

description:

description:

Uncle Joe becomes a justice of the peace with hopes of attracting honeymooners.

description:

title: Petticoat Junction
description:

Homer plans to keep the Cannonball from making its Christmas caroling tour.

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) becomes involved in a controversy between a teen (Carolyn Craig) and her overly possessive father (Ewing Mitchell).

description:

Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) try to discover the identity of a masked man known as the Robin Hood Kid (Tyler MacDuff).

title: Annie Oakley
description:

Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) step in when a young cavalry officer (Harry Lauter) is framed for murder.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E10 — Showdown at Diablo
Lofty (Brad Johnson) faces a moral dilemma when confronted with a notorious outlaw who once saved his life. With Lane Bradford, Bill Henry.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E12 — Renegade's Return
A notorious outlaw arrives during an election to shed a bad light on his brother, an honest lawyer running for office.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E16 — Outlaw Brand
The son (Stuffy Singer) of a slain deputy has suspicions about his caregiver (Leonard Penn), a reformed outlaw.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E19 — The Reckless Press
Annie, Lofty and Tagg (Gail Davis, Brad Johnson, Jimmy Hawkins) attend a friend's wedding and investigate the best man's murder.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E20 — Flint and Steel
Annie (Gail Davis) uncovers a scheme involving honest ranchers, a band of greedy crooks and a valuable oil pool. With Monte Blue, Jim Bannon.

title: Arizona Bound
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) team up to save a woman's stagecoach line from a Mesa City saloon gang.

title: Days of Jesse James
description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) clears the outlaw (Donald Barry) and his gang of a bank robbery done by bankers.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Riders of Destiny
description: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Death Valley
description: When a young man discovers gold, he must deal with threats.

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.

description:

The agents go to Wisconsin to investigate an Indian agent's claim.

description:

Pat and Stoney go to California to investigate reports of an anthrax epidemic.

description:

Trouble at a tungsten mine in San Pablo, Mexico.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:

Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll.

description:
S01 E15 — Herby Gets Drafted
Herby Bates, who is sweet on Billie Jo, won't be seeing much more of her, he has just been drafted.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E16 — Bobbie Jo and the Beatnik
Bobbie Jo falls for Alan Landman (Dennis Hopper), a poet and beatnik.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E17 — My Daughter the Doctor
Billie Jo discovers that her late father wanted her to be a doctor.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E18 — Hooterville vs. Hollywood
Kate asks the judge if she can legally keep Billie Jo from going to Hollywood.

description:
S01 E17 — Checkmate
Doc resorts to extreme measures to fund his free public clinic.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E10 — Citizen Romeo
The judge learns of a scheme to smuggle guns and ammo to the Indians and finds a way to break it up.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E35 — The Cross-Draw Kid
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge and Jeff take on the richest man in the valley over water rights.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E30 — The Defense Rests
Jeff Taggert's brother is accused of robbing the Del Rio bank; while investigating the case, Jeff becomes implicated in the hold-up.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E31 — Deliver the Body
Sheriff Blade arrives from Comstock to arrest rancher Del Randall on what appears to the Judge to be trumped-up charges; Bean and Taggart put Del in jail for safety while they investigate.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E18 — Desperate Journey
A young man is accused of murder; he makes a run for it.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E27 — The Elopers
Sharon Bender's father is killed when her intentions to marry Adam over his objections are known.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E19 — Eyes of Texas
Even though Judge Roy Bean temporarily loses his eyesight, he's still able to uncover a plot to steal Indian land.

title: Bells of San Angelo
description: A writer (Dale Evans) of cowboy novels saves herself and a border agent (Roy Rogers) with a trick from her latest book.

title: Down Texas Way
description: Three U.S. Marshals (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) work undercover to foil a gang of racketeers.

title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.
